claims.claim: Direct Belgium Gearbox (implies imported, tested used part from Belgium)
claims.evidence: No shipping labels, import documents, or country-of-origin markings are visible in any photo.
Witness saw a painted/stamped number ('39') and a yellow dot but could not read any brand, model, or part number confirming Ford Expedition V8 4WD fitment.

risks.risk: Transmission may not match Ford Expedition V8 4WD bellhousing/bolt pattern or electronics
risks.proof: Clear photo of the part/casting number tag or stamped ID plate on the case, matched against Ford parts catalog
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified used transmission, not model-specific

risks.risk: Internal wear: gears, clutch packs, torque converter, seals could be damaged or worn out
risks.proof: Video of the input/output shaft being rotated by hand, and a borescope or teardown photo of internals

risks.risk: Fluid leaks from seals or housing cracks
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seal areas and pan gasket with the unit stood upright, after wiping dry

risks.risk: Missing or damaged sensors, solenoids, wiring connectors
risks.proof: Full inventory photo of all connector plugs and sensor ports compared to a complete unit diagram

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/usage history, possible prior flood or accident damage
risks.proof: Seller-provided donor vehicle documentation, mileage sticker, or auction tag photo

risks.risk: No warranty or return policy stated
risks.proof: Screenshot or written statement from seller of warranty/return terms
risks.if_unproven: priced as sold as-is, no recourse

risks.risk: Unverified transmission type (manual vs automatic, number of speeds)
risks.proof: Photo of the shift selector port or ID tag indicating gear count and type

proof_requests: Close-up of the stamped/cast part number or ID tag on the transmission case
Photo of any Ford OEM sticker, barcode, or Belgium export/import paperwork
Video of input/output shaft manually rotated to show it turns freely
Photos of all seals and the pan area wiped dry to check for leaks
Statement and photo evidence of any warranty or return policy
response.reason: The witness confirms a generic used transmission/gearbox assembly, so it can be priced at worst case as an unverified, unidentified used unit; the Ford Expedition V8 4WD and Belgium-sourced claims are unverified and should not raise the price until a part/ID tag is shown.
